about: Cornwall Surfing Academy is a family-friendly surf school near Newquay that teaches at Holywell Bay and Fistral Beach. It focuses on beginner lessons, and its site says it has more than 22 years of experience.
where: Holywell Bay and Fistral Beach, Newquay
